source_data.desc:
_Creatures of variable appearance, soul eaters conjoin fleshy elements with ectoplasmic forms._  
**Called from the Abyss.** Soul eaters are summoned from the Abyss and other extraplanar ports of call where they can freely barter for prey. They always have a mental link with their summoner, and often seek to destroy them.  
**Devour Essences.** Soul eaters do not devour crude flesh, instead feasting on a victim’s soul and spirit.  
**Hatred of the Sun God.** They bear a particular antipathy for followers of the sun god, and they will go to great lengths to kill his clergy, even defying the wishes of their summoners on occasion.
source_data.name: Soul Eater
source_data.special_abilities_json: [{"name": "Caster Link", "desc": "When a soul eater is summoned, it creates a mental link between itself and its conjurer. If the soul eater's assigned target (see Find Target ability, below) dies before the soul eater can drain the target's soul, or if the soul eater is defeated by its target (but not slain), it returns to its conjurer at full speed and attacks. While the soul eater and the conjurer share the same plane, it can use its Find Target ability to locate its conjurer."}, {"name": "Find Target", "desc": "When a soul eater's conjurer orders it to find a creature, it can do so unerringly, despite the distance or intervening obstacles, provided the target is on the same plane of existence. The conjurer must have seen the desired target and must speak the target's name."}]

en.description:
_Creatures of variable appearance, soul eaters conjoin fleshy elements with ectoplasmic forms._  
**Called from the Abyss.** Soul eaters are summoned from the Abyss and other extraplanar ports of call where they can freely barter for prey. They always have a mental link with their summoner, and often seek to destroy them.  
**Devour Essences.** Soul eaters do not devour crude flesh, instead feasting on a victim’s soul and spirit.  
**Hatred of the Sun God.** They bear a particular antipathy for followers of the sun god, and they will go to great lengths to kill his clergy, even defying the wishes of their summoners on occasion.
en.name: Soul Eater

ru.description:
Существа переменного вида, пожиратели душ соединяют плотские элементы с эктоплазменными формами.

**Призванные из Бездны.** Пожиратели душ призываются из Бездны и других внепланарных портов захода, где они могут свободно обмениваться добычей. У них всегда есть ментальная связь со своим призывателем, и часто стремятся уничтожить их.

**Пожирают эссенции.** Пожиратели душ не пожирают грубую плоть, вместо этого пируют душой и духом жертвы.

**Ненависть к Богу Солнца.** Они питают особую антипатию к последователям бога солнца, и они пойдут на большие усилия, чтобы убить его духовенство, даже бросая вызов желаниям своих призывателей по случаю.
ru.name: Пожиратель душ
